description.narrative: Boost Africa will target start-ups and high-growth innovative African MSMEs, which play a crucial role in net job creation. Supporting startups and young growing MSMEs also means sustaining the democratisation of the economy, in a context characterised by an unequal distribution of wealth and high barriers for newcomers to start a business.
